summary: Gaps derived by comparing position training guides + PI spec against live PraxiumLaw UI (v0.3.0, phase 20).

gaps.user_story: New hire opens role guide inside the app
gaps.expected_ui: /training hub filtered by RBAC role + in-app gap list
gaps.current_ui: /training wired — contextual help on matter tabs still missing (UX-023)

gaps.user_story: Track Needs List checklist on day 0
gaps.expected_ui: Matter Intake tab with checkbox Needs List
gaps.current_ui: Intake tab wired — Needs List, Medicare flag, conflict status, team roles

gaps.user_story: Assign case manager, attorney, clerical, billing roles on matter
gaps.expected_ui: Team roles panel on matter (primary CM, supervising attorney)
gaps.current_ui: Intake tab — case manager, supervising attorney, intake staff dropdowns

gaps.user_story: Run conflict check before sign
gaps.expected_ui: Conflict check workflow + related cases linker
gaps.current_ui: Intake tab — conflict status + notes; no related-case linker yet

gaps.user_story: Open 3P claim day one; track adjuster, claim #, LOR sent
gaps.expected_ui: Insurance panel: 3P/1P entities, LOR status, acknowledgment
gaps.current_ui: Insurance tab — 3P/1P panels, adjuster, LOR, limits, liability

gaps.user_story: Record policy limits and claimant count for pro rata
gaps.expected_ui: Limits fields + alert when meds approach limits
gaps.current_ui: Insurance tab — limits display, BI per person/accident, claimant count, UM/MedPay fields

gaps.user_story: Maintain Meds ledger: balance, lien, FE, initials, COR
gaps.expected_ui: Medical tab with full provider ledger + COR flags
gaps.current_ui: Medical tab — editable Meds ledger (LTD/NTD, balance, lien, FE, COR, LOR status)

gaps.user_story: Alert on no-show, no MRI by ~8 weeks, treatment gap
gaps.current_ui: Medical tab — no-show / gap / MRI-overdue alerts from LTD/NTD + imaging pathway

gaps.user_story: Classify every inbound doc (Intake/Medical/Auto ins/etc.)
gaps.current_ui: Documents tab — required type on upload; MR/B/FE/COR for medical; filter + re-tag

gaps.user_story: Acknowledge redaction before carrier export
gaps.current_ui: Redaction checklist modal + carrier-share gate on medical/auto insurance docs

gaps.user_story: Build demand package per yellow-sheet order
gaps.expected_ui: Demand builder tab with exhibit order
gaps.current_ui: Demand tab — yellow-sheet exhibits, prep checklist, attorney approve/send gate

gaps.user_story: Attorney approves demand before send
gaps.expected_ui: Approval queue; staff blocked until attorney role approves
gaps.current_ui: Submit → attorney approve/reject → mark sent (403 without approval); GET /pi/demand/review-queue

gaps.user_story: Enter offers; attorney sets reduction %; net to client
gaps.current_ui: Settlement tab — offers log, scenarios from Meds, attorney reductions + net-to-client gate

gaps.user_story: Cases in PI phases: Treating → Record gathering → Demand…
gaps.current_ui: Pipeline tab + PI phase kanban on /matters + GET /pi/phases/report

gaps.user_story: Track rental, estimates, total loss, daily PD follow-up
gaps.current_ui: PD tab — vehicle, estimates, rental, loss of use, daily follow-up alerts

gaps.user_story: Text-only client line; coaching prompts at 3/7/30 days
gaps.current_ui: Comms tab — cadence prompts (3/7/biweekly/30) + contact log; VoxLine SMS still mocked Phase 2
gaps.workaround: Log calls/texts on Comms tab until Telnyx wired

gaps.user_story: Request records with date ranges; track LOR status
gaps.current_ui: Medical tab — records + LOR status per provider; no date-range LOR builder

gaps.user_story: COR required per provider when treatment complete
gaps.expected_ui: COR checkbox per provider in Meds
gaps.current_ui: Medical tab — COR status per provider + missing COR alert banner

gaps.user_story: Medicare/Medicaid/health plan lien path
gaps.current_ui: No subrogation module

gaps.user_story: Merge {{FIRM_NAME}} into letter templates
gaps.current_ui: Settings white-label profile + merged DOCX download at /settings/templates; intake checklist PDF

gaps.user_story: Firm accepts disclosure before using templates
gaps.expected_ui: Disclosure acknowledgment gate on first login
gaps.current_ui: Dashboard card only — no disclosure gate

gaps.user_story: Audit file vs timeline checklist (MRI, limits, subro…)
gaps.current_ui: PI audit dashboard at /reports — rolls up treatment, phase, PD, demand, comms, docs

gaps.user_story: Staff finds training from matter context
gaps.expected_ui: Contextual help links on matter tabs
gaps.current_ui: No contextual help on matter tabs

gaps.user_story: Staff nav hides attorney-only settings
gaps.current_ui: All nav items visible to every role

gaps.user_story: VA searches training + matters
gaps.current_ui: Command palette: matters/contacts only

gaps.user_story: Transfer to lit letters + phase change
gaps.current_ui: Status=litigation only; CourtConnect stub

gaps.user_story: Disbursement sheet + trust reconciliation
gaps.current_ui: Billing API stub; no UI

gaps.user_story: Cold phone lead greeting script
gaps.expected_ui: Lead script in training + intake form hints
gaps.current_ui: In-office coaching only in articles
